headline: Adopt {arm:atlas-m}. It is the only option that meets all quality gates while staying within the latency budget.
lede: {arm:atlas-m} passes all quality and latency criteria across every task. Relaxing the latency budget would allow consideration of {arm:atlas-l}.

slots.text: Deploy {arm:atlas-m}. It meets the quality threshold on all tasks and maintains p95 latency under {criteria.p95.threshold} seconds across the board.
{arm:atlas-l} breaches the latency budget on three tasks; {arm:brisk-s} and {arm:open-70b} fail multiple domain and safety quality gates.

{weakest.arm} sits directly on the threshold for {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.value|pct} against {weakest.threshold|pct} with a margin of {weakest.margin|pts}. Monitor resolution quality in troubleshooting.
Test speculative decoding or prompt pruning on {arm:atlas-l} to evaluate whether its p95 latency can reach the {criteria.p95.threshold} second target.

method.text: Requires meeting calibrated judge criteria per task alongside task-level p95 latency thresholds.
Measured end to end from user message submission to final generated token in staging.
Overall quality graded via a calibrated judge exhibiting {judged.overall.agreement|pct} agreement across {judged.overall.calibration_ratings} samples.
Derived from measured token consumption multiplied by vendor list prices per 1,000 replies.

sections.headline: {arm:atlas-m} clears every task gate while competing candidates miss on latency or accuracy.
sections.takeaway: Columns represent tasks; cells show gate compliance against quality and latency thresholds.

explore.title: Explore Gate Thresholds
explore.recomputes: Adjusting the p95 latency budget changes gate outcomes; raising the limit above {task.research.atlas-l.latency_s.p95} seconds enables {arm:atlas-l}.

durable_claims.text: {arm:atlas-m} achieved a mean of {task.trouble.atlas-m.resolves.mean|pct} on troubleshooting issue resolution, meeting the gate threshold of {criteria.trouble.resolves.threshold|pct}.
